description:
Get menstrual cycle tracking from Garmin Connect for a date: cycle day, current phase and days until the next, period and cycle length, predicted next cycle, fertile window and ovulation date, plus that day's logged symptoms and notes (day view). Fetched live from Garmin.

Returns a clear "not tracked" message when cycle tracking isn't set up. Defaults to today.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text (default), 'json' for complete structured data

name: garmin_get_womens_health
title: Menstrual cycle
